memory_update.text: The most direct US-listed AI cluster-connectivity semiconductor names have largely re-rated above the preferred USD 300M-10B discovery band; the next pass should search adjacent cable assembly, connector, compliance-test, and private-supplier ecosystems for overlooked public proxies.

Retimers, active electrical cables, CXL/PCIe interface IP, and smart fabric switches are distinct subnodes; later layers should separate direct module/chip revenue from upstream IP licensing and from broader server-cycle exposure.

Semtech is a discovery-lane candidate because CopperEdge creates a direct AI active-copper/signal-integrity link inside a company still commonly screened as analog/IoT/connectivity rather than pure AI infrastructure.
Rambus is a discovery-lane candidate for upstream PCIe/CXL IP exposure, but the AI-specific revenue bridge must be verified before promotion beyond Layer 1.

node: Retimers, active electrical cables, CXL/PCIe connectivity, and AI fabric switching
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the AI cluster-connectivity node around scarce signal-integrity and high-speed interconnect suppliers. The US-listed pure-play universe appears narrow and has already re-rated: Astera Labs and Credo are now high-attention reference names, while Semtech and Rambus remain better discovery-lane candidates because their AI connectivity exposure is embedded inside broader semiconductor/IP portfolios. No buy/sell view is implied; these are research candidates for evidence tracking.
